craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Dagger-bared-splitting; best-heroes close; vyanakṣi perfect kept per UNC. Rejected: (a) bared→drawn → killed: bared is exposed. Read aloud: IN-ward-POW-er DAG-ger-BARED … BEST-he-ROES in-DEED.

lines: Inward-power dagger bared — world-round splitting — by sword;
world by own power-glory taken — best heroes indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīm vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīm asinā | nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ

c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
